site.name: govuk-passport
site.summary: govuk-passport-clone Clone of a GOV.UK-style passport apply / renew multi-step form (one file, multiple steps). Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Single-page multi-step form with section switching: start page (eligibility, fees, required materials) → application type (new / renew / replace) → personal info → address → previous passport info → photo upload → review → stop before payment; step indicator on the left / top; each step has fields, hint text, inline errors, and an error summary; bottom "Save and continue" / "Cancel" | | `styles.css` | GOV.UK Design System style (black-yellow theme, Transport-like font stack, yellow focus outline, red errors) | | `script.js` | Step forward / back, field validation, error-summary focus, state persistence (localStorage) |

run_plan.goal: Critique and validate the end-to-end UX of the govuk-passport local demo’s multi-step passport apply/renew flow, including validation, error recovery, state persistence, and responsive/mobile behavior.
run_plan.summary: Start at index.html, handle cookie banner and enter the service via “Start now”. Progress through every visible step of the single-page form (eligibility/fees → application type → personal info → address → previous passport info → photo upload → review), intentionally triggering validation and using back/forward to assess state persistence and error-summary behavior. Repeat the critical path checks on mobile viewport to confirm layout/interaction fidelity.
assumptions: The entire multi-step experience is implemented within index.html via section switching (anchors like #service-start).
script.js handles step navigation, field validation, error-summary focus, and state persistence in localStorage.
There are no additional HTML pages beyond index.html in this prototype (services.css/js are included globally).
risk_hotspots: Cookie banner controls (Accept analytics / Reject analytics / View cookies): ensure it doesn’t block navigation and persists choice.
Step navigation + state persistence (localStorage) across back/forward and refresh within the single page.
Error summary + focus behavior when validation fails (ensure keyboard focus moves to the summary and correct field is indicated).
Photo upload step: interaction correctness for file input, preview/required validation, and error handling.
Review step: confirm it accurately reflects previous step inputs and that edits go to the right step/fields.
Mobile: small tap targets observed in top navigation and cookie buttons; re-check critical controls in the form for touch accessibility.

phases.title: Landing page & entry controls
phases.objective: Validate the demo landing experience and ensure users can reliably start the multi-step form regardless of cookie choice.
key_checks: On desktop: load index.html and verify the content matches “Apply for or renew a passport - GOV.UK local demo” with the “Start now ›” control visible.
Accept analytics cookies and then click “Start now ›”; confirm the service section becomes active (no blocking modal persists).
Repeat with Reject analytics cookies; verify the start flow still works.
Click “View cookies” and ensure it’s dismissible/doesn’t trap focus; then start the service.
Check that top nav links (Home/Service/Demo result) don’t break the active step state (they use anchor navigation).
exit_criteria: Start the service successfully at least once after Accept and once after Reject cookies.
Cookie modal/view state does not interfere with step content or navigation.
No console/network errors are present during entry.

phases.title: Happy-path traversal through all steps
phases.objective: Complete the full multi-step form flow (to the point where the prototype stops before payment) and verify correct step progression and UI consistency.
key_checks: Navigate through steps in order: start/eligibility & fees → application type (new/renew/replace) → personal info → address → previous passport info → photo upload → review → stop before payment.
Verify the step indicator (left/top) updates correctly on each transition.
Use “Save and continue” at each step (and “Cancel” at least once to confirm cancel behavior).
On each step: verify inline help text/hints are readable and that the correct input widgets are shown for the chosen application type.
exit_criteria: Every visible step’s main controls can be completed without blocking validation failures (using non-real test data).
No unexpected UI regressions occur between steps (fields don’t disappear incorrectly).
The user reaches the review/stop-before-payment stage.

phases.title: Validation & error recovery
phases.objective: Deliberately trigger validation failures and confirm error summary, inline errors, and recovery (back/forward) behave as intended.
key_checks: At multiple steps, attempt “Save and continue” with missing/invalid values to trigger inline errors.
Confirm error summary appears (if implemented) and keyboard focus moves to it (error-summary focus behavior).
From the error summary, confirm navigation to the correct failing field/section.
Trigger an error, then use browser back (or in-app back) and forward to ensure state is preserved and errors update appropriately.
Confirm that correcting a field clears both inline error and error summary on re-submit.
exit_criteria: Validation failures are reproducible on at least 3 different steps.
Focus behavior is correct: error summary receives focus and highlights actionable content.
Correcting inputs resolves errors without requiring full refresh.

phases.title: State persistence (localStorage) & refresh resilience
phases.objective: Verify that script.js persistence works and that the service resumes appropriately after refresh or partial completion.
key_checks: During the flow, partially fill fields on a mid-form step (e.g., personal info) but do not proceed; refresh the page and verify what persists.
Proceed to a later step (e.g., address), refresh, and confirm the active step and entered data remain consistent.
Complete photo upload step with a test image selection (non-sensitive) and refresh; verify preview/required state is handled (or fails gracefully with a clear message if persistence is not possible).
After reaching review, refresh and confirm the review reflects the latest stored values.
exit_criteria: At least 2 refresh scenarios show expected persistence (active step + inputs).
Photo upload persistence behavior is understood: either retained appropriately or produces a clear recovery path without broken UI.
No stale/contradictory review data is shown after refresh.

phases.title: Responsive/mobile verification of critical interactions
phases.objective: Repeat the most failure-prone interactions on mobile viewport to check touch target size, layout integrity, and keyboard focus behavior.
key_checks: Mobile viewport: enter the service from “Start now ›” (confirm cookie banner doesn’t block).
On at least one step, trigger a validation error and confirm the error summary and scroll/focus work on small screens.
Verify step navigation control (left/top indicator) is usable without mis-taps.
Re-check photo upload and review controls (buttons/inputs) for touch accessibility.
exit_criteria: Critical path (entry → at least one validated error recovery → review/stop-before-payment) succeeds on mobile.
No overlapping/hidden elements prevent completing required actions.
Touch interactions do not cause accidental taps on small controls.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all known HTML pages (index.html only).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise most visible controls per key page/step: cookie banner buttons, Start/Cancel, Save and continue/back, application-type choice, required form inputs, error summary navigation, photo upload, and review/stop-before-payment state.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (entry, one validation-error recovery, photo upload, review/stop state) on mobile viewport.

notes: The site is a single-page multi-step prototype; focus exploration on step transitions and state/validation behaviors rather than expecting navigation to additional HTML pages.
Observed small tap target warnings exist mainly in the top nav and cookie buttons; ensure the in-form controls meet minimum usability expectations on mobile during phase-5.

prescan_summary.title: Apply for or renew a passport - GOV.UK local demo
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: GOV.UK Home Service Demo result Local demo only. This is not an official GOV.UK or HM Passport Office service. Do not enter real passport, payment or personal information. Cookies on GOV.UK We use some essential cookies to make this website work. We'd also like to use analytics cookies so we can understand how you use the service and make improvements. Accept analytics cookies Reject analytics cookies View cookies Home Citizenship and living in the UK Passports, travel and living abroad Passports Apply for or renew a passport Apply online for a UK passport. You can also renew, replace, change details on, or apply for a child passport. This local version recreates the public GOV.UK page and a complete interactive form flow for demonstration and design review. You must use the official GOV.UK service for a real passport application. This page is an offline prototype. Start now › Before you
